title: Cheaply made, but cute presentation
text: When I saw this box, I immediately thought I need this for my cats. It looked so cute and fun. I was disappointed when I received my box though. The toys all had a theme which was really cute, but they were cheaply made and my cats were uninterested in them. Personally this item isn’t valuable enough for the cost. Just buy your cats toys they will like instead.
label: negative
